title: Filing: Shein says its US business is under FTC investigation and it is "cooperating", without giving specifics, as the company prepares for an IPO in Hong Kong (Gabrielle Fonrouge/CNBC)
summary: Gabrielle Fonrouge / CNBC: Filing: Shein says its US business is under FTC investigation and it is “cooperating”, without giving specifics, as the company prepares for an IPO in Hong Kong — Shein's U.S. business is under investigation by the Federal Trade Commission, the fast fashion giant revealed …
